- morning routine
- noon routine 
- evening routine 

but the app makes the order alphabetical so it looks like this

- evening routine
- morning routine
- noon routine

So If I’d be able to change the order myself it’d make me very satisfied.
Other than that I very much love this app It’s amazing just some details aren’t so perfect.
